trigger: Pre-generation audit found that the initial generation-brief builder replaced only names in the selected scene's characters list. Free-text retained fields could still contain names of context-only characters from the same work. This violates the frozen deidentification intent and increases source-imitation risk.
immutable_after_amendment: all hypotheses, selector rules, treatment rules, evaluation rubric, and PASS/HOLD/FAIL gates from parent preregistration

repair_rule.selected_scene_characters: Map selected scene characters deterministically to P1..Pn in original characters-list order.
repair_rule.context_only_character_names: Build the union of all character names present in runtime_scene_projection records for the selected work. Any known work-character name not in the selected scene speaker list is mapped deterministically to X1..Xm using Unicode lexical order after removing selected speakers.
repair_rule.replacement: Replace known character names in all retained free-text fields, longest-name first to prevent partial replacement.
repair_rule.source_record_and_sample: No source record may be replaced, removed, or added because of deidentification difficulty.
repair_rule.hard_audit: Before any Control prose generation, remaining hits of any known work-character name in any generation brief must equal 0. If not, HOLD_DEIDENTIFICATION and do not generate.

versioning.generation_briefs_r2: Must be regenerated from the same frozen 24 source records and SHA-sealed after this amendment.
